## 3. Optional C23 Annex K profile

Annex K is optional in C23 and **Excluded** from this library's core
claim. No safe module exports any `_s` symbol; symbol-absence is pinned
by `test/compile_fail/c23_annex_k_absent.sv0` (C23K-001).
